(A) Includes additional pro forma interest expense of $5.5 million ($3.3 million net of tax), which assumes that the "Spin-Off" of Unisource occurred on October 1, 1995.
(B) Earnings Per Share has been calculated using the actual net income for the current year and pro forma net income for the prior year.

(C) Fiscal 1997 shares represent weighted average outstanding Unisource common shares for the six-month period plus the dilutive effect of stock options. Fiscal 1996 shares for the six-month period represent actual outstanding Unisource common shares as of December 31, 1996 ("Spin-Off" date) plus the dilutive effect of stock options.
